sentences.text: 2. The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with Alamganj P.S. Case No. 361 of 2024 for the offences punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, lodged on 30.04.2024 by the informant, Neha Kumari.

3. As per the prosecution story, the informant who is serving as a A.N.M in the Primary Health Centre, Guljarbagh, Patna alleged that the petitioner who is serving in the Ground-D job at Hazarat Nizamuddin, New Delhi were studying together in Class 9th when in the garb of putting vermilion on her head, established physical relationship.
When the lady asked for proper marriage, it was refused on the ground that both do not belong to the same caste.
The allegation is that they wanted Rs.25,00,000/- and in the meantime, continued physical Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.77696 of 2024(2) dt.12-11-2024 relationship for seven long years, this led to the F.I.R.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that a perusal of the F.I.R. would show that only to put pressure on him to solemnize marriage as he is in the government job, the F.I.R. There is no allegation of rape, rather, the allegation is that promising marriage, the physical relationship was established.
He submits that the lady is major and was well aware of the relationship that she alleges continued between the accused and her.

sentences.text: 5. Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer submitting that she has made allegation of putting vermilion and establishing physical relationship.

6. Considering the submissions put forward by the parties as also the fact that the allegation is of establishing relationship in the garb of marriage, both are major, are in job, F,I.R. lodged, it has undertaken by learned counsel for the petitioner that he shall be diligently appearing in trial, is in custody since 20.07.2024 (paragraph no.11 of the petition) having no criminal antecedent, this Court is inclined to extend him the privilege of bail.
